meta.description: Orvex & Co. Advisory connects refineries, institutional buyers and mining investors with vetted, duly authorized counterparties in Burkina Faso, under a compliance-first, non-custodial framework.

hero.eyebrow: Gold Sourcing & Mining Advisory · Burkina Faso
hero.h1: Burkina Faso gold, transacted to institutional standard.
hero.sub: Orvex & Co. Advisory connects refineries, institutional buyers and mining investors with vetted, duly authorized counterparties in Burkina Faso — under a compliance-first, non-custodial framework.
hero.assure: We never take title to metal or hold client funds. Settlement moves bank-to-bank between buyer and authorized exporter.

flow.title: Settlement path
flow.orvexSub: No custody of funds or metal. Our fee is disbursed under the IMFPA at settlement.

pillars.h2: A transaction discipline built for a high-scrutiny market.
pillars.intro: West African gold carries a reputation that serious buyers cannot ignore. Our framework is designed to answer every question a refinery compliance officer will ask — before the first introduction is made.

p1.title: Compliance Before Introduction
p1.body: No seller documentation is released until a counterparty has completed KYC, submitted a Client Information Sheet and provided verifiable proof of funds.

p2.title: Non-Custodial by Design
p2.body: Orvex never takes title to metal and never holds buyer funds. Payment flows directly between the buyer's bank and the authorized exporter's bank.

p3.title: Global Standards, Local Execution
p3.body: Our process is aligned with OECD due diligence guidance and Burkina Faso's Mining Code, and executed on the ground in Ouagadougou by vetted, licensed partners.

p4.title: Verification at Every Stage
p4.body: Export authorizations, permits and assay results are independently verified before settlement, not after.

commitments.h2: Commitments we hold on every engagement.

c1.title: Zero upfront fees
c1.body: Buyers are never asked to pay taxes, customs or handling fees before a verified assay.

c2.title: Bank-to-bank settlement
c2.body: Funds move only between the buyer's bank and the licensed exporter's bank.

c3.title: NCNDA & IMFPA on every deal
c3.body: Every introduction is protected by executed non-circumvention and fee-protection agreements.

c4.title: OECD-aligned due diligence
c4.body: Supply-chain risk is assessed against the OECD framework for high-risk areas.

c5.title: Bilingual documentation
c5.body: Every engagement is supported in English and French, the working language in Burkina Faso.

stages.h2: Five stages from inquiry to settlement.

s1.title: Qualification
s1.body: Inquiry, KYC and proof of funds.
s1.detail: The counterparty submits an inquiry, completes KYC, returns a Client Information Sheet and provides verifiable proof of funds. No seller documentation is released before this stage is complete.

s2.title: Protection
s2.detail: Non-circumvention and fee-protection agreements are executed, so that every introduction is protected from the outset.

s3.title: Verification
s3.body: Full Corporate Offer and licence checks.
s3.detail: The Full Corporate Offer is reviewed, and export authorizations, permits and licences are independently verified.

s4.title: Assay & Logistics
s4.body: Independent assay; FOB or CIF execution.
s4.detail: The metal is independently assayed before settlement, and delivery is executed FOB Ouagadougou or CIF. Buyers are never asked to pay taxes, customs or handling fees before a verified assay.

s5.title: Settlement
s5.detail: Payment moves directly from the buyer's bank to the authorized exporter's bank, with no intermediary account. Our fee is disbursed under the IMFPA at settlement.
